title: [MPS] index_copy leads to incorrect values
bug_description:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

Reproducer:

```
import torch

x_cpu = torch.randn((5, ), requires_grad=True)
src_cpu = torch.randn((5,), requires_grad=True)
index = torch.randint(0, 5, (5,))

x_mps = x_cpu.detach().to("mps").requires_grad_(True)
src_mps = src_cpu.detach().to("mps").requires_grad_(True)
index_mps = index.to('mps')

out_cpu = torch.index_copy(x_cpu, 0, index, src_cpu)
out_mps = torch.index_copy(x_mps, 0, index_mps, src_mps)

torch.testing.assert_close(out_cpu, out_mps.cpu())

```

On the recent main branch build of Torch.
```
Mismatched elements: 1 / 5 (20.0%)
Greatest absolute difference: 2.463545083999634 at index (3,) (up to 1e-05 allowed)
Greatest relative difference: 1.259730577468872 at index (3,) (up to 1.3e-06 allowed)
```


Will take a look today/tomorrow

### Versions

Main branch build of Torch:
torch==2.10.0a0+git798a6d2
